title: G1 benchmark criteria (map query cost and memory, judged at 80 m)
source: DESIGN.md 5.2, Table 9 (R6); DECISIONS.md D-010, D-012, D-028; PLAN.md G1 line
design_text_verbatim: Query: at 80 m (D-012), B median operations per query ≤ 1 % of the flat-list tests (≤ 4,000).
Query: at 80 m (D-012), B median operations per query < the equal-resolution student grid.
Memory: at the largest arena where cells touched < 37 %, B (merge on) memory < A memory.
A fail of any line gets a root-cause memo. The line does not move.

judged_scope.input: synthetic only (200 robots, 20 trips, 100 points per trip, 400,000 points, fixed generator seed)
judged_scope.input_note: Replay inputs come from 10 m runs, so no replay exists at 80 m. Replay rows are reported, not judged

structure_names.grid_eq: 3. student grid at equal resolution, n = L / s_min

line_1.metric: B median operations per query, 80 m, synthetic
line_1.threshold_basis: 1 % of 400,000 synthetic points, the cost of one flat-list scan over all points. DESIGN.md 5.2 line 1 and the PLAN.md G1 line give the same number
line_1.contrast: B vs one full flat-list scan
line_1.reported_not_decisive: B median divided by the measured flat-list median at 80 m

line_2.metric: B median operations per query, 80 m, synthetic
line_2.contrast: B vs the student grid at equal resolution, same input, same arena

line_3.selector: the largest arena in line_3_candidate_arenas_m where cells touched < 37 %
line_3.cells_touched_source: the cells touched (%) column of structure A on the synthetic input
line_3.test: B (merge on) memory bytes < A memory bytes, strict, at the selected arena
line_3.contrast: B vs A, same input, same arena
line_3.no_arena_selected: no candidate arena has cells touched < 37 %. Then line 3 is not resolved. Root-cause memo. The 37 % and the candidate list do not move
line_3.why_capped_at_80_m: D-012 judges G1 at 80 m only. Larger arenas are reported, not judged. DESIGN.md line 3 names no arena cap, so this file applies the D-012 cap. Needs the M3-10 D-row to confirm

verdict.per_line: pass or fail for each of the 3 lines. line_3 may also be not resolved
verdict.G1: pass only if all 3 lines pass. fail if any line fails. not resolved if no line fails and line 3 is not resolved
verdict.multiplicity: 3 separate line verdicts. The report shows each line and does not average them

precondition.equivalence: A and B return the same cell on every query (DESIGN.md 5.2). Any difference stops B, and no G1 line is judged on B
precondition.R6: A and B equivalence fails on 2026-11-21 → ship A, D-row (DESIGN.md Table 9, verbatim)

noise_basis: Operation counts and memory bytes are deterministic for a fixed generator seed. One run gives the exact value. So the lines are exact comparisons with no margin
failure_condition: Any line that fails gets a root-cause memo. The line does not move. G1 is then reported as fail

reported_not_decisive.percentiles: 95th percentile and maximum operations per query

rec_period_axis.reported: every output column per rec_period value
rec_period_axis.why: answers the GCFA logging-interval future work on the cost side (research/applied_vs_not.md 4 P6). The G1 verdict stays at 80 m on the synthetic input (D-012)
rec_period_axis.fallback: benchmark wall time over 300 s with the axis → axis dropped, D-row (research/applied_vs_not.md 4 P6)

output.records: this file path and its sha256, analyze.py sha256 (rules/measurement.md 4.1)

change_rule: Nothing here changes after the first benchmark run. A needed change makes a new file and a new run
